findings.desc: quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:174 — non-null assertion cache! is unsound (TypeScript cannot infer process.exit(1) as noreturn, so cache remains FindingSignalsCache|null at this point) and the as-number cast that follows is redundant (typeof cache?.coveredFindingCount === 'number' already narrows it). Fix: pull the null guard into a real branch before this line (e.g. if (!cache) { ... return; }), then drop both the non-null assertion and the cast.

quality-cleanup: learning-validate.ts:129+146 — coverage gap comparison is scoped incorrectly when args.story filter is active. deriveFindingSignalsFromStore is called with { storyIds } (single-story subset), so cache.coveredFindingCount/.coveredStoryCount reflect only that one story. But readFindingSignals(cwd) on line 145 reads the FULL persisted cache (all stories). computeCoverageGap then compares partial current counts against a full persisted watermark, producing a confusing/misleading gap line (e.g. persisted=50 findings, derived=3 for one story => gap shows 0 because max(3-50,0)=0 — a false in-sync signal). Fix: skip the coverage gap report (or emit 'coverage: n/a (filtered view)') when storyIds filter is active.

CHK-001:happy:0 — applyDoneMergeEffects passes no `now` to deriveFindingSignalsFromStore so the written cache always has updatedAt=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z\" (epoch) instead of the current wall-clock time. The intent says \"updatedAt advances\"; the implementation regresses it. The smoke (assertHappyRefreshesCacheOnMain) never asserts cache.updatedAt, so this bug passes all 15 checks undetected. Fix: add `now: new Date().toISOString()` to the deriveFindingSignalsFromStore opts at done-effects.ts line 927. Add a smoke assertion: assert cache.updatedAt > \"2020-01-01\" (or similar recent floor).

CHK-001:edge:0 — the intent is \"refresh runs on EVERY DONE merge, not gated on material-code change\". The smoke only drives one scenario where a material code file (packages/main/src/app.ts) IS committed. There is no scenario where the story branch carries ONLY metadata changes (no code file, no build predicate hit) and the refresh still fires. Without this second scenario the edge case is asserted by the evidence note alone, not by an executable assertion. The implementation is correct (the refresh block at done-effects.ts:925-932 is not inside any shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths guard) but the smoke does not prove it. Fix: add a second control scenario to done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts where the story branch commits only story metadata (no packages/main/ code changes) and assert the advisory \"experience cache refreshed\" line still appears.
